**Disposition: ACCEPTED** for both-policy preparation fuzz on pin 375b621b. This rests on graded replays: the original mining and d2 raw runs kept no certificates or models, so those lost bytes themselves were never re-checked. The earlier NOT ACCEPTED in the addendum stays on record, and both earlier reports are unchanged byte-for-byte (e648d19f…, 8a721895…). There was no solver change, and none of the 40,062 new graded runs failed.

Report: `benchmarks/runs/20261002-shared-policy-feedback-fuzz-owner-375b621b/FINAL_REPORT_CLOSEOUT.md` (sha256 1eb5b3aa…)
Status: `OWNER_CLOSEOUT_STATUS.md`

| Job | Role | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1747298 | Mining replay smoke, 24 cases (not counted) | 24/24 pass |
| 1747299 | d2 graded reruns, 3 configurations | 3/3 pass |
| 1747300 | Full mining replay, 20,000 cases, two graded twins each | 19,096 pass, 904 timeouts, 0 failures |
| 1747314 | Second stage, 600 s deadline, 4 cases | 4/4 pass |

All four completed 0:0, with no throttle and no node constraint. The plan and runner were hash-frozen before any submission, and every job checked the snapshot, pin and checkers before and after its run.

**C1 — mining scan.** All 19,084 original completions are now resolved: 19,080 at 30 s and the last 4 at the 600 s stage.
- **How each completion was checked:** the identical invocation was run twice (A and B) on the same pin, CNF and seed, and both runs were fully graded.
- **Determinism:** A and B are byte-identical in proof, s/v lines and the feedback stream (without its timing records).
- **Match to the original:** verdicts equal the original exit codes, and all 51 original hit rows match.
- **Run census:** 40,008 graded runs gave 22,782 SAT, 15,422 UNSAT and 1,804 solver timeouts. There were 0 checker timeouts, rejections or errors, and every checker status was `verified`.
- **The 916 original timeouts:**
  - 897 timed out again in both twins;
  - 16 completed in both twins and were graded;
  - 3 completed in one twin only, which was graded.

**C3 — d2 raw runs.** The six graded reruns are UNSAT and verified. For each configuration, off and on proofs are byte-equal. Each run's s-line, conflicts, decisions, stress fires, stream line and record counts and session end exactly equal the retained original raw values. The two k5 rerun proof sizes also match sizes I saw while d2 was running, but that listing isn't a saved file, so I cite it only as supporting.

**C2 — terminal postflight.** It ran after all 11 owner jobs had finished and returned status 0.
- Pin: 173 binaries and 795 sources match, and `src/include/tools/tests` are unchanged at HEAD 335c511a.
- Checkers 895f1989… pass at both locations.
- Snapshots s1, f1 and the closeout snapshot c1 all match their recorded digests, and so does the leg harness 1fceb82e….
- d1 and d2 still had no checks inside their own jobs. This later check shows nothing changed after them, but it doesn't supply those missing checks.

**What still stands as limitations:**
- The replay scope above.
- The 6 feedback-variant timeouts remain non-evidence; they come from the very large feedback-recording overhead on the Debug CLI (68–88×).
- Producers that are unavailable natively: Condition needs an offered witness, native SubstitutionRedundancy was never effective, LocalSearchGuidance and Propagate effects come only from mining, and the Factor terminal arm was never reached.
- The six control runs on the old defective pin f6f01982 are not candidate results and have no proof/model check of their own. The matching runs on this pin are all graded.

The fresh 100,000 seeds per policy are unchanged and remain the only fresh credit. Nothing was committed or pushed. Whole-goal acceptance, docs and the Andrew handoff stay with Codex.
